title.zh: SEC Crypto Broker Rule Enters White House Review
title.en: SEC Crypto Broker Rule Enters White House Review

current_state.zh: The SEC's planned amendments to broker-dealer rules for crypto assets — covering capital requirements, customer-asset safeguards and recordkeeping — have entered White House review, moving the package closer to formal proposal.
current_state.en: The SEC's planned amendments to broker-dealer rules for crypto assets — covering capital requirements, customer-asset safeguards and recordkeeping — have entered White House review, moving the package closer to formal proposal.
